verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau pasaau kar nira(n)kaar aakaar banaiaa|

en.bdb: With a single Word that formless Lord created the whole world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੋਲਿ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਨਾ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: tol atol naa toleeaai tul na tulaadhaar tolaiaa|

en.bdb: Extension of the Lord (this world) can in no way be measured.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਅੰਗੁ ਨ ਅਖਰੁ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lekh alekh na likheeaai a(n)g na akhar lekh likhaiaa|

en.bdb: By no account this world can be understood because all numerals and letters come to an end for this.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਨ ਮੋਲੀਐ ਲਖੁ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: mul amul na moleeaai lakh padhaarath lavai na laiaa|

en.bdb: Myriad kinds of its materials are invaluable; their price cannot be fixed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਿ ਅਬੋਲੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bol abol na boleeaai sun sun aakhan aakh sunaiaa|

en.bdb: Even through speech, nothing can be said and heard about it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: agam athaahu agaadh bodh a(n)t na paaraavaar na paiaa|

en.bdb: This world in unapproachable, unfathomable and full of mystery; its mystique cannot be understood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kudharat keem na jaaneeaai kevadd kaadhar kit ghar aaiaa|

en.bdb: When it is impossible to understand the creation, how could its Creator's greatness and His residence be known?

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukhafal saadhasa(n)g sabadh surat liv alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the holy congregation where by merging the consciousness in the Word that invisible Lord is visualised.
In the holy congregation, the unbreakable cup of love is drunk by becoming tolerant.
